<function name="ClientSignOnStateChanged" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>
Called when a player's sign on state changes.
<bug issue="4899">You cannot get a valid player object from the userID at any point during this hook.</bug>
</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<added>2021.03.31</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="userID" type="number">The userID of the player whose sign on state has changed.</arg>
		<arg name="oldState" type="number">The previous sign on state. See <page text="SIGNONSTATE">Enums/SIGNONSTATE</page> enums.</arg>
		<arg name="newState" type="number">The new/current sign on state. See <page text="SIGNONSTATE">Enums/SIGNONSTATE</page> enums.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
